TEXT: The next day.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hello.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Welcome, Ayase. We were waiting for you.
That Kirino... She actually called her here.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Onii-san as well... It's been several days since we last 
saw each other.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah.

Now that she mentions it. I did meet her during the 
first half of summer vacation.

In my eyes, Ayase-sama is an existence that 
deserves awe and reverence.
Fortunately, she seems to be in a good mood today.

Normally, I would be feeling relieved with the 
thought "It seems today will end without any pain".

But. Things are different today, I might have to 
ignite the fuse to the bomb myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You keep staring at my face... Is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: N-No, nothing at all?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Hey, what are you doing Kyousuke? You're in the 
way if you keep standing there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Just quickly go get the drinks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yes, ma'am.
What a cheeky little sister.
If she weren't my girlfriend, I'd get angry.

However, just by changing her title from little sister 
to girlfriend...

Her irritating attitude now seems really cute to me. 
It was strange.
Yeah, I'm all fired up now.
With this, I'll have the power to fight Ayase...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ----"Kyousuke"?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Kirino... You just called Onii-san "Kyousuke", didn't 
you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah, I did.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]GYAAAAAAAH![/font_size]

Impossible, impossible, impossible, impossible!!! 
What's with this overwhelming pressure!
It's like I'm being crushed just by being here...!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: What's the meaning of this? ...Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
It's tiring to talk while standing, so let's just head in 
for now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I have no intention of lying to you, since I called you 
here today just to talk about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ......Alright.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: E-Err.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll go get the drinks.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Please wait.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Before that... Let's talk.
